repos.name: VIctory-NVIDIA
repos.description: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.

repos.name: nospeaker
repos.description: make your macbook's trackpad talk using its haptic motor
repos.readme_snippet:
Mute your Mac. Your trackpad will still talk.
There's no speaker in a MacBook trackpad, just a small haptic motor that taps the glass so you feel a click.
NO SPEAKER drives that motor up to 4,000 times a second, fast enough to make sound you can hear, and turns it
